forward_patch:
--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B4002GZV6E43G5CQ74BJNZ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 9a80
+title: 'Mutations: tags, tag rename, and comments'
+---
+## What
+Tag and comment mutations. The basis is plan.md §4.2, §6.2, and §3.2 (a comment is a full node).
+- `addTag`/`updateTag`/`deleteTag`/`undeleteTag(id, name, color, body)`: `addTag` is idempotent on slug; `updateTag` does not change the slug; auto color when no color is given.
+- `renameTag(from!, to!)`: new tag `set` (copied values, only if `to` does not exist), and old tag `set renamedTo = tag/<to>`. A rename to an existing slug is a merge (only the redirect). A rename that makes a cycle gives `TAG_RENAME_CYCLE`. All refs to a redirected slug follow the redirect (`addTag`, `updateTag`, `deleteTag`, `renameTag`).
+- `addComment(task, body, actor)` / `updateComment(id, body)` / `deleteComment(id)` / `undeleteComment(id)`: mint a ULID; author = explicit `actor` or the session actor; an unknown author is created. Comment refs need only the comment id.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] After `renameTag(bug → defect)`, tasks with `bug` show `defect`, and `#bug` still matches.
+- [ ] `deleteTag(id: "bug")` after the rename deletes `defect`.
+- [ ] `updateComment(id:)` works with only the comment id.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Mutations/TagCommentTests.swift`: rename, chain, merge rename, cycle refusal, comment CRUD and undelete, plus the matching Rust dispatch tests.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter TagCommentTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
